title: HubSpot
content:
# HubSpot

Connect a HubSpot portal to sync inbox contacts and messages, and to count closed-won deals as sales in ad results or send them to ad platforms.

Connect a HubSpot portal to a profile and Zernio keeps it in step with that profile's inbox. Its closed-won deals can also count as sales on your ad campaigns.

A connected account uses `platform: "hubspot"` and represents one portal.

## Quick reference

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Platform value | `hubspot` |
| What it syncs | Inbox contacts to HubSpot contacts, inbox messages to their timeline |
| Deals | Closed-won deals as sales in campaign results and ad rules, or as purchases sent to ad platforms |
| Workflows | A `hubspot_upsert_contact` step creates or updates the contact at any point in a flow |
| Auth | OAuth: the Zernio app is installed on the portal |
| Scopes | `oauth`, `crm.objects.contacts.read`, `crm.objects.contacts.write`; optional `crm.objects.deals.read` |
| Portals per profile | One |
| Social posting | No |
| Analytics | No |
| Settings | `syncContacts` and `logMessages`, on by default; `useDealsAsResults` and `reportDeals`, off by default |

## Before you start

The person connecting must be a HubSpot user who can install apps on the portal. Messages sync only for conversations linked to a Zernio contact.

With [zero content retention](/security/zero-content-retention) on, timeline entries carry only their heading ([inbox sync](/platforms/hubspot/sync#how-it-behaves)).

## Connect

Call `GET /v1/connect/hubspot` with the profile and send the user to the returned `authUrl`. They pick the portal and approve the app. See [Connect](/platforms/hubspot/connect).
